clips.speaker: nova
clips.text: Gia, the aquarium needs two superheroes. Will you and Penguin choose bubble power?

clips.speaker: nova
clips.text: Bubble power activated! You and Penguin are making the aquarium shimmer.

clips.speaker: nova
clips.text: More moon bubbles! Pop, pop, pop!

clips.speaker: luma
clips.direction: Warm, delighted Australian accent; musical and unhurried, never a caricature.
clips.text: Oh! Bubble power tickles! I'm Luma. Gia and Penguin, tap my moon bells and make a song with me!

clips.speaker: luma
clips.direction: Warm Australian accent; delighted discovery with a gentle musical cadence.
clips.text: You beauty! Our bells woke three moon pearls. Follow their glow to Ocho!

clips.speaker: ocho
clips.direction: Friendly male Boston accent; confident neighborhood warmth, theatrical but never exaggerated or parodied.
clips.text: Hey, Gia and Penguin! I'm Ocho. Tap each moon pearl and I'll conduct the aquarium song!

clips.speaker: ocho
clips.direction: Friendly male Boston accent; warmly impressed and playful.
clips.text: Beautiful moon pearl! It found its note.

clips.speaker: ocho
clips.direction: Friendly male Boston accent; amused and delighted by repetition.
clips.text: Again? Absolutely! Watch all eight arms!

clips.speaker: ocho
clips.direction: Friendly male Boston accent; proud, joyful finale without shouting.
clips.text: Gia and Penguin, that's our moonlight song! The whole aquarium is glowing!

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Gia and Penguin's Bubble-Power Adventure. One moonlit night, Gia arrived at the aquarium with Penguin tucked safely under her arm. They heard a tiny splash at the door. Nova Kitty needed two superheroes. Gia chose bubble power. Penguin held on tight as a bright blue bubble spun around them, and the sleepy aquarium began to shimmer.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Gia and Penguin watched one enormous moon bubble float all the way to the twinkling water.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Gia used her bubble power again and again while Penguin bobbed happily beside her. Enormous moon bubbles danced toward the twinkling water.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Then Gia and Penguin met Luma the moon jellyfish and made his bells glow with a sparkly song.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: The glowing bells led Gia and Penguin to Ocho, an octopus with eight arms and a moon-pearl baton.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Gia placed the blue circle moon pearl while Penguin kept the beat.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Gia placed the gold star moon pearl while Penguin kept the beat.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Gia placed the coral diamond moon pearl while Penguin kept the beat.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Gia played the moon pearls again, and Ocho conducted with more and more arms while Penguin danced faster.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Ocho lifted his baton. Luma shimmered, Nova Kitty purred, and Penguin stood proudly beside Gia as the whole aquarium played Gia's moonlight song.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Nova Kitty purred. The animals knew you and Penguin would find a wonderfully bubbly way to help.
